description: This file defines the WeakPasswordException class, a custom exception in the OpenMRS API indicating that a password is considered weak, such as being a common word or matching user identifiers.

classes.name: WeakPasswordException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a password is weak, extending PasswordException.

methods.name: WeakPasswordException()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the exception with a standard message indicating a weak password.

methods.name: WeakPasswordException(String message)
methods.description: Constructor that allows setting a custom message for the weak password exception.
